data.description:
## Description

What: Parser fail-soft behavior (exit 0 with WARN: to stderr on unparseable comments) plus a repeated-failure escalation counter keyed (reviewer_id, github_comment_id, parse_error_class) persisted in the CENTRAL telemetry store (not ${ARTIFACTS_DIR}, which does not persist across CI runs): on each parse failure the adapter writes a parse_failure event; on run start it queries COUNT(*) of parse_failure events for the key for the current commit_sha; when count >= 3 it auto-files a bug via .claude/scripts/dso ticket create bug ... tagged origin:bot-parser-drift. Why: parser drift against evolving bot formats must not break CI and must be triaged. Scope IN: parser exit-0+WARN fail-soft, central-store-persisted counter, the >=3-consecutive auto-bug-file with origin:bot-parser-drift tag, header_drift parse_error_class emission. Scope OUT: the parser body normalization (draft-3); thread resolution.


## Done Definitions

- Injecting a malformed bot-comment fixture causes the parser to exit 0 and write WARN: to stderr; CI stays green ← Satisfies: sc-6
- The (reviewer_id, github_comment_id, parse_error_class) failure counter is read from and written to the central telemetry store; across 3 simulated CI runs the count reaches 3 (proving cross-run persistence, not reset to 0 each run) ← Satisfies: sc-6
- On the 3rd consecutive parse failure for the same key, a bug ticket is auto-filed via the ticket CLI with tag origin:bot-parser-drift ← Satisfies: sc-6
- An integration test exercises the 3-consecutive-failure escalation in a configuration-isolated environment (HOME set to an empty directory, no pre-existing artifacts, no global git config, no pre-set environment variables from the developer's machine) and the test passes, proving the counter survives across simulated CI run boundaries rather than relying on a developer-machine ${ARTIFACTS_DIR} ← Satisfies: sc-6

## Considerations

- [Persistence] The counter MUST live in the central telemetry store; ${ARTIFACTS_DIR} does not survive across CI runs and would silently reset the counter.
- [Idempotency] Auto-bug-filing should be idempotent per (reviewer_id, github_comment_id, parse_error_class) so a 4th failure does not file a duplicate ticket.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a pipeline maintainer, I want malformed bot comments to keep CI green and auto-file a bug after 3 consecutive parse failures, so that parser drift is surfaced as actionable work without breaking the pipeline.
